purpose: permit full offline optimization with blind synthetic model-node responses while preserving strict separation from formal live acceptance

pseudo_live.generator_isolation: blind to target score, hidden golden artifact, evaluator-only rubric/output, future node outputs, competing candidates and candidate ranking

model_call_requirement: Every model response required by the executed path must have provenance appropriate to the active execution mode. A deterministic executed path with zero model nodes does not require a model call.
offline_loop: deterministic checks -> blind pseudo-live responses -> graph execution/materialization -> lineage validation -> pseudo score -> diagnose/repair -> repeat until convergence/budget -> freeze best candidate -> live acceptance
anti_cheat: frozen simulator policy within evaluation regime
no candidate-specific answer shaping after score observation
no hidden golden/reference leakage to response simulator
pseudo score never copied into formal score fields
